previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: PTY factory rejects reused descriptor numbers and can leak a newly allocated pipe pair
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: PTY open closes its initial input pipe, retains both numbers in owned_fds, then allocates the foreign pipe.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: own_fd rejects any number already in owned_fds even when its earlier generation is closed. pipe2 may reuse the just-freed numbers; rejection occurs after allocation and before both new descriptors are registered, so rollback/close does not own the new generation. The normal advertised PTY frontend cannot reliably reach its constructors.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Track active descriptor generations separately from immutable closure history. Register both pipe/openpty descriptors transactionally and close the exact newly allocated generation on every registration/capacity failure. Do not erase earlier closure evidence.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static allocation/control-flow defect; no PTY or pipe was executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Active FD-generation map is separate from append-only birth/closure history; full pair transaction reserves before effect, registers/configures both before returning, exact private generation rollback; ordinary reuse after proved close removes active entry only.
